No Terms . Total value wise evaluation: i. Bidder shall quote for all the items and full quantity of each item. ii. The evaluation will be done considering all the items as a set and L1 will be arrive 1 d based on overall lowest for the set. iii. Quotation for partial items/ partial quantities will not be considered. iv. Contract will be placed based on overall L1. Specifications of Ring Filter with Incandescent Lamp I. Incandescent Lamp: 1. The average mean spherical candela power is 0.030 to 0.040 2. Operating voltage: 5 Volts DC/5 Volts AC at frequency of 400 Hz 3. Current requirement: ≤ 70 mA 2 4. Lifetime (hours): ≥ 55,000 5. Filament type: C-2R 6. Type of wire terminal: T-3/4 7. Diameter of the bulb: 2.3 ± 0.1 mm 8. Length of the bulb: 3.3 ± 0.6 mm 9. Wire terminal: 32 ± 0.6 mm

II. Ring Filter: 1. Outer diameter of the ring filter is 4.7 mm 2. Inner diameter of the ring filter as appropriate to incandescent lamp dimensions 3. It has to be with heat sink on one upper end. 4. Length of the ring filter is to be between 4 mm to 4.5 mm 3 5. The ring filter has to transmit Green A colour 6. NVIS radiance has to comply to MIL-STD-3009 standard 7. Ring filter has to compliant to MIL-L-85762 A and MIL-STD-3009 standard 8. It has to work up to extended temperature ≥ 100° 4 Deliverables: It is required to deliver 100 ring filters and 100 incandescent lamps. Delivery Schedule: Material should be delivered within 90 days from the date of Ge M Contract/ Purchase Order. 5 However early deliveries are acceptable. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The incandescent lamp has to work with 5V DC / 5 V AC with 400 Hz. 2. The incandescent lamp has to fit inside the ring filter. 3. The OEM test reports or certificate of conformance (COC) of OEM/ Vendors COC/ di 6 stributors COC, covering the NVIS radiance of ring filter, ring filter dimensions and o perating temperature, and the incandescent lamp dimensions, operating current, voltage specifications, and other technical details to be provided. Final acceptance is at BDL, Kanchanbagh after verification of deliverables, as per th e Specifications Documents.
